LanguageData.BI_Auto_Desc: When on, this drafted pawn fights on its own: picks the most dangerous enemy, finds cover, uses its abilities and pulls back when badly hurt. Your orders always come first – it only acts when the pawn is standing idle.
LanguageData.BI_Stance_Desc:
Click to change.

Attack – goes after enemies, moves freely to a good firing spot.
Defend – stays close to the place where you put it (moves only to nearby cover).
Hold – never moves, only shoots and uses abilities from where it stands.
LanguageData.BI_Abilities_Desc: Choose which abilities this pawn may use on its own.
LanguageData.BI_AbilitiesHelp: Ticked = used on its own in combat. Abilities that are not combat abilities (social, rituals, travel…) are never used alone.
LanguageData.BI_Kind_Ignore_Desc: Social, ritual, travel or very risky ability – never used on its own.
LanguageData.BI_Kind_Attack_Desc: Used on the most dangerous enemy in range – not on a target that already has the effect, and not when one of yours is in the line of fire.
LanguageData.BI_Kind_Area_Desc: Used only on a group of enemies (see 'area attack from') and never when one of yours is inside the area.
LanguageData.BI_Kind_SelfBuff_Desc: Used on itself when enemies are close and the effect is not active yet.
LanguageData.BI_Kind_AllyBuff_Desc: Used on itself or a drafted ally in range who does not have the effect yet, when enemies are close.
LanguageData.BI_Kind_Heal_Desc: Used on the most hurt ally in range (bleeding or badly wounded).
LanguageData.BI_Kind_GameAI_Desc: The game itself knows when to use it – used on enemies when the game says it makes sense.
LanguageData.BI_Kind_Unknown_Desc: The mod cannot tell what it does, so it is off. Switch it on for a pawn (Abilities… button) and it is used like an attack.
LanguageData.BI_Rec1: Drafted pawns fight on their own in the 'attack' stance; an attack drafts the fighters by itself.
LanguageData.BI_Rec2: Cover, focus fire, no shooting through your own people, retreat when badly hurt.
LanguageData.BI_Rec3: Combat abilities (psycasts, genes, races, implants) used at the right moment.
LanguageData.BI_OtherMod: Another auto-combat mod is active – use only one of them, or both will give orders.
LanguageData.BI_Enabled_Desc: Master switch for the whole mod.
LanguageData.BI_DefaultOn_Desc: New pawns start with battle instinct on. You can still switch it per pawn with the button.
LanguageData.BI_Mechs_Desc: Your drafted mechs fight on their own too.
LanguageData.BI_FocusFire_Desc: Pawns prefer the enemy that others are already shooting, so it goes down faster.
LanguageData.BI_UseCover_Desc: Ranged fighters without cover move to the nearest spot with cover from which they can still hit.
LanguageData.BI_AvoidFF_Desc: Does not shoot when one of yours stands in the line of fire or right next to the target – picks another target or moves.
LanguageData.BI_Retreat_Desc: A badly hurt or heavily bleeding pawn runs to a place the enemies cannot see (not in the 'hold' stance).
LanguageData.BI_ShowText_Desc: A short text above the pawn: cover, focus fire, falling back, ability name.
LanguageData.BI_RetreatHp_Desc: Overall health under which the pawn pulls back.
LanguageData.BI_BleedHours: Retreat when bleeding out in: {0} h
LanguageData.BI_BleedHours_Desc: Pulls back when it would bleed out in less than this.
LanguageData.BI_DefRadius: Defend stance – move up to: {0} cells
LanguageData.BI_DefRadius_Desc: How far from the place you put it the pawn may move to find cover.
LanguageData.BI_AggRadius: Attack stance – move up to: {0} cells
LanguageData.BI_AggRadius_Desc: How far the pawn may go in one move to get a good shot.
LanguageData.BI_UseAbilities_Desc: Psycasts, gene abilities, race abilities and implants – every ability of the game and mods that use the game's ability system.
LanguageData.BI_NoOverheat_Desc: A psycast is not used when it would push neural heat over the limit.
LanguageData.BI_AoeMin_Desc: How many enemies must be in the area before an area ability is used.
LanguageData.BI_Interval_Desc: How often each pawn decides again. Shorter = faster reactions, a bit more work for the game.
LanguageData.BI_AutoAlarm: Alarm: draft fighters on their own
LanguageData.BI_AutoAlarm_Desc: When enemies attack the home map, colonists who can fight (healthy adults, best armed first) are drafted on their own and go after the enemy. One wild animal: only two of them. About 20 seconds after the last enemy is gone they go back to work. Anyone you undraft yourself is left alone until the attack is over.
LanguageData.BI_Kite_Desc: A shooter steps back a few cells when a melee enemy gets close, then keeps shooting (not when the enemy is much faster).
LanguageData.BI_Screen_Desc: Melee fighters first hit enemies that reached one of your shooters and otherwise stand two steps in front of the nearest shooter.
LanguageData.BI_Rescue_Desc: When no enemy is close, a drafted colonist carries a downed colonist to a bed.
LanguageData.BI_Cohesion_Desc: A pawn far ahead of the others waits for them instead of running into the enemy alone.
LanguageData.BI_Engage_Desc: Pawns in the attack stance (and those the alarm drafted) only go after enemies this close to them or close to your base. Raiders still far away at the map edge are left alone until they come closer; the alarm waits for them too.
